summary: Photo-led hero after Foundever: an edge-to-edge people photo with a very large two-line heading over its top-left corner, and a solid white card that overlaps the lower-left edge of the photo and runs below it, holding the lead, the buttons and up to three proof ticks. Up to three figures sit in a quiet row beside the card. The photo settles from a slight zoom on load and moves a little slower than the page on scroll; the heading words rise once. Needs one wide photo of real people at work (client photo first, library photo otherwise) with the subject away from the top-left corner, a short heading (about 2-6 words per line), and the usual hero copy. Suits contact centers, CX and staffing companies whose people are the product.
